entries.decision: Decorate only an actual V1.0 XSD INVALID result caused by exact PDF spelling HertbeatIntervall or by duration-shaped content at SystemConfigurationData/HeartbeatIntervall where the selected XSD requires IBIS-IP.double.
guards: must require official V1.0 strict profile and XSD INVALID
must not treat PDF HertbeatIntervall as an alias
must distinguish SystemConfigurationData IBIS-IP.double from StoreSystemConfigurationRequestStructure IBIS-IP.duration
must not normalize to V2.0 HeartbeatInterval

entries.decision: Decorate only an actual V2.0 XSD INVALID result caused by exact stale HertbeatIntervall/HeartbeatIntervall spelling or non-duration content for HeartbeatInterval.
guards: must require official V2.0 strict profile and XSD INVALID
must not accept HertbeatIntervall or HeartbeatIntervall as aliases
must preserve HeartbeatInterval as the sole V2.0 identifier
must not back-normalize to the V1.0 identifier

entries.decision: Warn only on the exact documentation typo SystemDocumenationService in resolver/codegen/documentation-derived service identity input.
guards: must not register SystemDocumenationService as an alias
must not fuzzy-match arbitrary service names
